# Rohit Dubey — AI & Full-Stack Developer (Full Documentation)

## Overview
Rohit Dubey is an AI and Full-Stack Developer specializing in building modern web applications, AI tools, Chrome extensions, and full-stack software.

## Technical Architecture & Engineering Skills

### Languages
- Python: Experienced with automation scripts, GUI tools (Tkinter), and AI/LLM integration.
- JavaScript (ES6+): Deep DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming, event handling, and single page applications.
- TypeScript: Typed development for scalable React applications.
- Java: Data Structures and Algorithms practice.
- SQL: Database querying syntax (PostgreSQL/NeonDB).

### Frontend Development
- Frameworks & Libraries: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion), Three.js, GSAP.
- UI Engineering: Responsive layouts, dark mode UI, micro-animations, interactive canvas components.

### Backend & Cloud Engineering
- Server Tech: Node.js, Express.js REST APIs.
- Authentication: OAuth 2.0 / Google Cloud Console integration.
- Storage: PostgreSQL (NeonDB), Browser Local Storage, Chrome Storage API.
- Cloud & Hosting: Vercel (Frontend deployment), Railway (Node.js backend deployment), Hostinger.

### AI & Generative AI Engineering
- OpenAI API: Structured JSON output generation, prompt engineering, canvas tool integration.
- Anthropic Claude API: Resume parsing analysis, scoring heuristics, personalized roadmap generation.
- LLM Standards: llms.txt, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), JSON-LD Schemas.

## Project Case Studies

### 1. NoteLift (Published Chrome Extension)
- Status: Live on Chrome Web Store (v0.2).
- Problem: Students need a seamless way to capture and organize key highlights from online PDFs and web pages without context-switching.
- Solution: Lightweight Chrome extension using Manifest V3 that captures selected text, organizes notes module-wise, stores them locally, and exports to TXT or Markdown.
- Tech Stack: JavaScript, Chrome Extension APIs, Chrome Local Storage.

### 2. Brainstormzz (AI Whiteboard Application)
- Status: Live.
- Problem: Brainstorming sessions lack structured AI-driven visual expansion.
- Solution: Interactive whiteboard UI where single prompts generate multi-category structured idea cards with refinement tools.
- Tech Stack: React 18, HTML5 Canvas, Tailwind CSS, OpenAI API.

### 3. AI Career Engine
- Status: Live.
- Problem: Job seekers need actionable insights bridging their resume to target job descriptions.
- Solution: Dual-mode application offering career role discovery and job description overlap scoring with a 12-week custom roadmap.
- Tech Stack: React, Vite, Node.js, Express, pdfjs-dist, Multer, Anthropic Claude API, deployed on Vercel & Railway.

### 4. Devinterio (Commercial Client Work)
- Status: Live at devinterio.com / devinterio.in.
- Scope: Complete redesign and rebuild of an interior design business website with ongoing post-launch maintenance.
- Outcome: Commercial client deployment with responsive design and fast load speeds.

### 5. SSB Practice Simulator
- Status: Live.
- Solution: Test simulator for Services Selection Board aspirants with strict timed modules for WAT, PPDT, and SRT tests.

### 6. RailDost
- Status: Prototype / Showcase.
- Solution: Visualized route and travel-time comparison tool for Indian Railways using Leaflet.js maps.
